title: Vickers Wellington T2520
memorial_details: description: Cairn comprising various sized boulders, leading up to a peak.  At top centre a large wooden Latin cross with a plaque. At the base a smaller wooden cross with metal plaque, date inscribed thereon. All six crew on board the aircraft were killed on return from a bombing mission to Bordeaux, 9 December 1940. No names are listed on the memorial.
